svg.text: The same 57 stages in black. Nine changes, one colour each, each one lit only at the stages it actually touches.
separated from the trigger; it is what answers WHY NOW
the line cannot cross an unaccepted return
C5 DRIVER ORIGIN — WANT beside NEED
nine origins; want is not folded into need
none-natural / self / distributed / external / joint / meta
C7 PASS 0 — DECLARE THE END FIRST
the end decides which earlier reality matters
thirteen named patterns — doc, deliberately not code
removed, and kept visible so they cannot creep back
the END is declared BEFORE this is looked for. Without that the reverse walk expands forever.
P1 SEED BEFORE CARRIER — the cause can be older than the thing that carries it. Karna's seed is older than Karna.
struck: the word “child”. It implied younger, and it implied software recursion. It is a SUB-SEQUENCE.
P2 ACTOR VIEW — the same event is a different sequence for each actor, according to what that actor knew.
struck: filling a gap with an invented source. The gap stays a gap and goes to the human.
threshold TIME — the window opening is why it happens NOW.
P7 CONVERGENCE WINDOW — several sequences must land inside one window or nothing happens.
P4 EXCEPTION CONTRACT — a rule bent once, with terms. The terms are the code, not the bending.
the threshold sits on the EDGE entering this stage. It was wrongly held inside the state before.
P6 DOWNSTREAM-CRITICAL CHANGE — small now, decisive far later.
this is the ENTITY's outcome. It is not the sequence closing. Collapsing these two was the worst error in every
threshold ABSENCE — what fires it is that maintenance STOPS. Absence is a threshold type.
nine driver origins, and WANT sits beside NEED — never folded into it. Gravity has NATURAL DYNAMICS and no driver at
all; that is a real value, not a missing one.
the CONTROLLER is named here: none-natural · self · distributed-self · external · joint · meta.
P12 REPRESENTED FUTURE — a sequence acted on because it was foretold, not because it happened.
P11 PROMISE AS CODE — a vow binds future transitions. Bhishma.
SPAWN. close_condition ≠ acceptance_condition — a sub-sequence can close and still not be accepted.
a LEDGER row opens. BARRIER: the main line cannot cross this node while a required return is unaccepted.
struck: the in-place retry. LOCATE → BUILD → SUBSTITUTE are three sub-sequences, not one node run three times.
threshold EVENT — a candidate is present.
spawn RE-ANGLE: closed at “new angle set”, accepted only when the structure holds.
P3 PRIORITY / ARBITRATION — two rules both apply; name what decides between them.
the controller is recorded here, not assumed.
struck: blending two surviving reasons. Two survivors HALT.
threshold EVENT — and the encounter is CONDITIONAL. Two sequences meeting is never an assumption.
threshold RANGE — the boundary is reached.
P13 RESULT MULTIPLICATION — one transition, many results, on many lines, at different times.
P5 LATENT RESULT — it exists and it has not fired. Waiting is a state.
spawn REPAIR: closes when the repair is done, accepted only when the requirement is met.
P9 OBSERVER / WRITER — the record is its own sequence with its own intent. Sanjaya is not a camera.
threshold COUNT·QUORUM — a second independent witness.
struck: averaging two witnesses that differ. That HALTS; the gap is the Mask.
P10 RULE INERTIA — the rule keeps running after the reason for it is gone.
NEW STAGE. Six values, and they belong to the SEQUENCE.
it can only close when the ledger is empty.
P8 CLOSURE SCOPE — whose closure. A war closing is not a family closing.
struck: the word CLOSURE used of an entity.
NEW STAGE. Thirteen values — persists, coheres, degrades, terminates — and none of them is “closed”.
struck: reopening S₀. S₁ REFERENCES S₀ and S₀ stays closed.
threshold EVENT — the seed is accepted.
the end PASS 0 declared is checked here: did we arrive at the reality we named at the start?
Two stages are entirely new — SEQUENCE CLOSURE and ENTITY OUTCOME. Everything else was already on the line; what changed is what each stage is now required to carry.
The thirteen primitives (C8) sit in the document, not in the code. Six enforceable objects only — or the next consolidation quietly drops half of them, as every prior one did.
Read with the arrow chart: C1 is annotated here at the stages where the threshold changes the reading, but all 22 thresholds are drawn there, on their own edges.
